issues.title: Keyboard focus is hard to see in a fictional form

hypotheses.claim: The focus outline blends into the background
hypotheses.test: Inspect the synthetic focus state and compare outline contrast against the adjacent surface
hypotheses.counterexample: The outline contrast is already sufficient in the synthetic fixture

hypotheses.claim: The focus outline is clipped by a container
hypotheses.test: Render the fictional form with and without overflow clipping
hypotheses.counterexample: The outline remains hidden even when clipping is disabled

issues.title: Fictional dashboard has a confusing empty state

hypotheses.claim: The empty-state message does not say how to reset filters
hypotheses.test: Check a synthetic zero-result state for a visible reset action
hypotheses.counterexample: A visible and keyboard-accessible reset action already exists

hypotheses.claim: A stale filter persists after clearing the search
hypotheses.test: Simulate a clear-search action and inspect the active filter state
hypotheses.counterexample: All filters are cleared in the synthetic state transition
